'''Rust Squadron''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit led by [[Dorrian Vodani]] and stationed at [[Arda Base]]. The name started as a joke but was adopted by the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. It was in operation by the time of the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], and conducted patrols and escort missions in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] sector. The squadron fought in the Battle of the Gauntlet, but during the evacuation had to remain aboard the [[Transport/Legends|transports]] as they lacked [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]].

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rust Squadron appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''.
